name: TimeReport
description: Consultant hours reporting plus progress: subtask and time meters on board cards, project and milestone progress, and XP with levels. Pick a project and date range, choose breakdowns, optionally add an AI summary, copy as Markdown or export CSV.
author: Carmelo Santana

recommends.reason: adds an AI narrative summary of the completed work (the report works fully without it)
adds party XP totals: an owner's level includes their agents' work (progress works fully without it)
